label: TEMPLATE / demo
topic: Lesson 27: Work Rate (工作效率／工程問題)
formulas: Work done ÷ Time = Rate (工作效率)
Work rate = the amount done in one unit of time (單位時間內完成的工作量)

questions.title: Find the rate
questions.q: Mrs. Brown made 14 buns in 2 hours. Mrs. Smith made 18 buns in 3 hours. Who works faster, and by how many buns per hour?

options.A: Mrs. Smith, by 4 buns per hour
options.B: Mrs. Brown, by 1 bun per hour
options.C: Mrs. Smith, by 1 bun per hour
options.D: They work at the same rate

questions.explanation: Rate = work ÷ time. Mrs. Brown: 14 ÷ 2 = 7 buns/h. Mrs. Smith: 18 ÷ 3 = 6 buns/h. 7 − 6 = 1, so Mrs. Brown is faster by 1 bun per hour.

wrong.A: You compared the totals (18 − 14 = 4). You must first divide each total by its time to get the rate (工作效率).
wrong.C: You found the difference of 1 correctly but picked the wrong person: Mrs. Brown's rate (7) is higher than Mrs. Smith's (6).
wrong.D: Check the division: 14 ÷ 2 = 7 and 18 ÷ 3 = 6 — they are not equal.

questions.mistakes: Comparing totals instead of rates; dividing time by work.

questions.title: Find the time
questions.q: Lucas reads 8 pages per hour. How many hours does he need to read a 48-page storybook?

wrong.A: You subtracted (48 − 8). To find time, divide the work by the rate.
wrong.B: You multiplied (48 × 8). Rate × time gives work, but here we already know the work — divide instead.
wrong.D: You added (48 + 8). Use time = work ÷ rate.

questions.mistakes: Multiplying or subtracting instead of dividing.

questions.title: Find the work done
questions.q: Emma sews 12 shirts per hour. She sews for 3 hours. How many shirts does she sew altogether?

wrong.A: You divided (12 ÷ 3). 12 is already the amount per hour; for 3 hours multiply.
wrong.C: You added (12 + 3). Each hour she sews 12, so it is 12 + 12 + 12 = 12 × 3.
wrong.D: You subtracted (12 − 3). Use work = rate × time.

questions.mistakes: Dividing or adding instead of multiplying.

questions.title: Compare rates
questions.q: Big sister takes 6 hours to finish a job alone. Little sister takes 4 hours to finish the same job alone. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Big sister is faster because she works more hours
options.B: They are equally fast because it is the same job
options.C: Big sister does 1/4 of the job each hour
options.D: Little sister is faster because she does 1/4 of the job each hour, more than 1/6

questions.explanation: Treat the job as 1. Big sister: 1 ÷ 6 = 1/6 per hour. Little sister: 1 ÷ 4 = 1/4 per hour. 1/4 > 1/6, so little sister is faster — same job, less time.

wrong.A: More hours for the same job means slower, not faster. Rate = work ÷ time.
wrong.B: Same job, but different times, so the rates are different.
wrong.C: You mixed up the sisters: big sister takes 6 hours, so she does 1/6 each hour.

questions.title: Find the time
questions.q: A machine makes 120 parts per hour. How many hours does it need to make 960 parts?

wrong.B: You subtracted (960 − 120). Divide the work by the rate.
wrong.D: You divided 960 by 80 or guessed. Check: 120 × 12 = 1440, too many.

questions.title: Working together
questions.q: Mum cleans 8 windows per hour and Dad cleans 12 windows per hour. The house has 40 windows. If they clean together, how many hours will it take?
questions.explanation: Together their rate is 8 + 12 = 20 windows per hour. Time = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 hours. Check: Mum 16 + Dad 24 = 40.

wrong.A: You used only Mum's rate (40 ÷ 8). When working together, add the rates first.
wrong.B: You subtracted the rates (12 − 8 = 4, 40 ÷ 4). Working together means adding rates.
wrong.D: 20 is their combined rate per hour, not the time. Next step: 40 ÷ 20.

questions.mistakes: Using one person's rate; subtracting rates; stopping at the combined rate.
